verdict.rationale: Osborne Clarke is a law firm, but it does ship digital client tools (an online investor-readiness check), so a natural-language or AI command interface is a fair question. Nothing in the evidence shows the firm or its tools can be operated through natural-language commands. The only machine-facing probes (llms.txt and OpenAPI paths) all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
